obligations.name: one-event closure rank
obligations.evidence: All 3200 complete projective-line closures add one dimension over W0.
obligations.scope: Linear, scalar, group-law, and charged affine-transport post-processing.

obligations.name: two-line independence
obligations.evidence: All 11200 distinct-line pairs add two dimensions with zero discrepancies.

obligations.name: P-256 derived-row replay
obligations.evidence: 1024 distinct derived rows retain rank 164; the independent primitive reaches rank 165 across 1844 group replays.
obligations.scope: Synthetic deterministic labels, not a relation construction on FB1hc72514a2a8d3.

obligations.name: two-primitive P-256 event
obligations.evidence: No non-scalar-labelled mechanism emits two independently certified quotient lines.

obligations.name: complete below-rho recovery
obligations.evidence: The two-primitive free oracle is above rho and no complete relation/decomposition/recovery pipeline exists.

controls: The toy census enumerated and replayed 6722800 exact equations, 3200 line closures, and 11200 distinct-line pairs with zero discrepancies.
Five P-256 stages were ranked over two fields in both row orders and replayed through 1844 exact group equations.
Rounds 39, 304, and 306 were imported only after exact byte-hash, schema, curve, factor-base, boundary, and gate checks.
cost_accounting: Measured: complete toy equation enumeration, line partition, rank operations, P-256 scalar multiplications, group additions, equation replays, process telemetry, and artifact sizes.
Imported without extrapolation: Round-304 unquotiented, two-primitive, and known-anchor oracle boundaries.
Unset: a non-labelled two-primitive event, relation yield, structured solver, sparse linear algebra, target recovery, and complete attack cost.
exploration_boundary: Exact for rows derived from one primitive equation using pre-event equations and linear group-law operations; not a bound on a search that independently discovers a second equality.
weakest_open_obligation: Construct and replay one non-scalar-labelled P-256 mechanism that independently certifies two quotient lines, then price complete recovery below rho.
narrowest_supported_finding: Arbitrarily many rows obtained by replayable post-processing of one primitive event add at most one dimension modulo pre-event knowledge. A second dimension requires independently certified information.
